messages:
alex: heads-up — planning a terraform apply for networking + IAM tonight during the 23:00 UTC change window. provider pin + one egress rule for partner integration. plan: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-512

deploy-bot: scheduled terraform plan -> apply in 2h (initiator: alex). CI plan link: https://ci.redwood.dev/plan/8234 :robot_face:

maya: i'm +1 for provider pin. recommend serial apply: network first, then iam. will run connectivity smoke after network.

jordan: agree on serial. also add canary region (us-west-2) only initially for networking. no global rollout until smoke passes.

alex: ok will target us-west-2 for module.network. runbook snippet i'm planning to use:
```
# network first
terraform apply -target=module.network -auto-approve
# wait for probes (~2 min)
terraform apply -target=module.iam -auto-approve
```

deploy-bot: reminder: remember to update providers.lock before apply if provider pin changes. CI will fail if lockfile mismatch. :warning:

maya: added note — run `terraform init -reconfigure` in CI to ensure provider cache aligns with pin.

sre-oncall: i'll be on pager for the window and watching health dashboards. set alert if auth errors > 0.5% for 5m.

alex: small change to plan: also add a temporary "circuit_breaker" remote flag in SSM to allow instant rollback of traffic routing if bad.

jordan: nice. add the runbook to use SSM to flip circuit breaker and route traffic back to stable cluster.

samir: quick question — provider pin version 4.7.1 or 4.6.x? 4.7.1 has the fix but CI might need minor module updates.

maya: we've validated modules with 4.7.1 in staging. i'll update providers.lock and push a commit now.

deploy-bot: apply job started by maya at 1841210450

deploy-bot: plan output: `+ module.network.aws_security_group_rule.partner_egress` etc — ready to apply. Approving as maya.

deploy-bot: apply failed during module.iam: `Error: Incompatible provider version`\nprovider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws 4.6.0 required by lockfile, current target 4.7.1.

alex: hmm — looks like some modules still reference older provider constraints. maya, can you run `tf providers lock` and re-run plan?

maya: on it. i updated the module constraint and regenerated the lockfile. pushing commit.

jordan: if we can't reconcile in 15m -> abort apply and open an incident; fallback plan is to revert network change (if applied) and schedule a paused rollout.

deploy-bot: re-plan started by maya at 1841210602

deploy-bot: apply resumed and succeeded. resources applied: network rules, ssm parameter, iam changes (minor role binding update). :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: post-checks: auth smoke PASSED, egress verification to partner IP ok, latency unchanged.

alex: thanks all. follow-ups: add provider constraint note to the release checklist and add a preflight script to validate lockfile before window. filing INF-518 for that.

maya: noted. pushing a short PR for the preflight script.

samir: closing loop — no rollback needed. leaving the circuit_breaker flag in place for 24h.

alex: nice job everyone. :tada:
